PluginData.Author: Zeo-Corps
PluginData.Tooltip: 1.0.2 — 31 built-in SDX main-drive variants and searchable GPS dropdown.
PluginData.Description: Zeo Nav 1.0.2 adds an explicit catalog of all 31 inspected SDX main-drive variants and a search field beside the native GPS dropdown. Type part of a name, select a match, then start. Preserves precision attitude, own-ship Spectrum limits and automatic overlay shutdown. Requires compatible world/server telemetry for Spectrum features. Windows / Pulsar Legacy. Disable old local Nav entries, refresh sources and fully restart to update.
